    • addLifeformToCabin

      public void addLifeformToCabin(int i, int j, LifeformType lifeformType) throws IllegalArgumentException, TooManyAliensException, TooLowDifficultyLevelException, OutOfGridException, OutOfShipException, NoSupportVitalFoundException
      Adds the given lifeform to the given cabin. If an alien is added, it also checks whether the given cabin has a matching vital unit attached
      Parameters:
      i - Row where the given cabin is located
      j - Col where the given cabin is located
      lifeformType - Type of lifeform to add to the ship
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the ship can have the given alien type onboard but the given cabin is not empty, or if the given alien type is null or unrecognised
      TooManyAliensException - If a player tries to add a second alien of the same type
      OutOfGridException - If the given coordinates fall out of the grid
      OutOfShipException - If the given coordinates fall out of the ship
      NoSupportVitalFoundException - If the given lifeform is an alien and the cabin has no matching vital units as its neighbours
      TooLowDifficultyLevelException - If the current difficulty level does not allow to add aliens to a ship

    • getNearestComponents

      public Component[] getNearestComponents(Component component) throws NullComponentException, NullPointerException
      Returns the direct neighbours of the given component in the following order:
      • Index 0 - Top
      • Index 1 - Right
      • Index 2 - Bottom
      • Index 3 - Left

      NOTE: The direct neighbours are NOT diagonal, thus only the top, right, bottom and left adjacent components are considered as neighbours of the given component.
      NOTE: This method differs from getNearestReachableComponents only for the reachability aspect, meaning that these neighbours CAN OR CANNOT be reachable from the given component, therefore you should mind which method to use in your specific case.
      Parameters:
      component - The component of which we want to get its direct neighbours
      Returns:
      A Component[] array of size 4 with the given component's neighbours
      Throws:
      NullComponentException - If the given component is null
      NullPointerException - If the position of the given component fails to yield legal coordinates

    • getNearestReachableComponents

      public Component[] getNearestReachableComponents(Component component) throws NullComponentException, NullPointerException
      Returns the direct neighbours of the given component in the following order:
      • Index 0 - Top
      • Index 1 - Right
      • Index 2 - Bottom
      • Index 3 - Left

      NOTE: The direct neighbours are NOT diagonal, thus only the top, right, bottom and left adjacent components are considered as neighbours of the given component.
      NOTE: All returned neighbours (if any exist) are also REACHABLE from the given component, meaning that the connectors that bridge the gap between the latter and each neighbour are checked for validity. An invalid pair of connectors between two components implies that from the given component that particular neighbour cannot be reached, therefore the latter is not reachable from the former.
      Parameters:
      component - The component of which we want to get its direct neighbours
      Returns:
      A Component[] array of size 4 with the given component's neighbours
      Throws:
      NullComponentException - If the given component is null
      NullPointerException - If the position of the given component fails to yield legal coordinates

      public void addComponent(Component component, int i, int j) throws NullComponentException, OutOfGridException, ExistingComponentException, OutOfShipException
      Adds the given component at the given coordinates (i, j) in the ship's component grid.

      Throws:

      ExistingComponentException - If the component at coordinates (i, j) is already occupied
      OutOfShipException - If the given coordinates (i, j) fall outside the ship profile, determined by the current difficulty level

    • removeSingleComponent

      public void removeSingleComponent(int i, int j) throws OutOfGridException, OutOfShipException, CoreDeletionAttemptException
      Removes ONLY the component at coordinates (i, j) from the ship's grid
      When compared with the other method removeComponent(), the former doesn't check for any hanging branches that resulted from the removal of that particular component, whereas the latter does so. Also, this method is intended to be used mainly by the player, since he can specify precisely the component to remove, in the context of fixing the ship when the method validateShip() returns FALSE.
      Parameters:
      i - The index of row that contains the component to delete
      j - The index of column that contains the component to delete
      Throws:
      OutOfGridException - If the given coordinates (i, j) fall outside the grid
      OutOfShipException - If the given coordinates (i, j) fall outside the ship profile, determined by the current difficulty level
      CoreDeletionAttemptException - If the given coordinates (i, j) correspond to the ones of the core

    • removeComponent

      public List<Component> removeComponent(int i, int j) throws OutOfGridException, CoreDeletionAttemptException
      Removes the component at coordinates (i, j) from the ship's grid.
      If that component, when removed, divides the ship into 2 or more branches, then the method keeps the branch that also has the core component and discards others (as if they were left hanging without support).
      Parameters:
      i - The index of row that contains the component to delete
      j - The index of column that contains the component to delete
      Returns:
      The components removed from the ship, which are the selected one at coordinates (i, j) and any components that were left hanging from the ship as a consequence of the removal of the selected component.
      Throws:
      OutOfGridException - If the given coordinates (i, j) fall outside the grid
      OutOfShipException - If the given coordinates (i, j) fall outside the ship profile, determined by the current difficulty level
      CoreDeletionAttemptException - If the given coordinates (i, j) correspond to the ones of the core
